<?php
function factorial(int $n): int {
    $result = 1;
    for ($i = 2; $i <= $n; $i++) {
        $result *= $i;
    }
    return $result;
}

echo factorial(5), "\n";

def factorial(n)
  (1..n).reduce(1, :*)
end

puts factorial(5)

def fibonacci(count):
    a, b = 0, 1
    out = []
    for _ in range(count):
        out.append(a)
        a, b = b, a + b
    return out

print(" ".join(str(n) for n in fibonacci(10)))
